short_summary.value: Directional message arbiter that selects one of five directional input messages for forwarding to the next network stage.
short_summary.explanation: The module receives five directional drive events (East, Local, North, South, West) each with a 51-bit message payload, and a single freeNext input. It outputs a single selected message and five directional free signals. The single instance arbMerge (cArbMerge5_51b) performs the arbitration and message selection logic.
